trigger.conflict_error: CONTRADICTED needs a complete structured conflict.

c_review_details.meaning: Removed extra conflict.kind_note and supplied exact expected conflict fields; added a second relevant quote. Verdict remained CONTRADICTED. This is schema/evidence-form recovery, not semantic label correction.

limitations: AI-drafted references and AI semantic reviews remain provisional; repeated outputs are paired within the same twenty cases.
Raw M1 content retention is distinct from structural completion, standalone fidelity and strict joint success.
Recorded reference token prices give cost estimates, not billing totals.
latency_boundary_note: Published call latency is the RecordingClient complete duration from call-results.latency_seconds. Provider transport trace duration is also reported independently; two phase means differ by about 0.5–0.8 ms because of the wrapper boundary. Cost and token totals do not depend on either latency boundary.

supplementary_raw_verdict_diagnostic.qualification: Supplementary post-run diagnostic only. It ignores the extra top-level field to inspect already parsed raw claims; invalid responses remain public-invalid and frozen primary metrics are unchanged. No repair, new inference, selection or altered reference labels. The original raw_label_correct metric is conditional on a strict claims-only envelope and must not be described as all readable raw verdicts.

issues.reason: 第一个 NF span 覆盖整句“既然公共阅听室内所有播放录音的访客都需要佩戴耳机…”，包含 t1 的真实事实前提。reason 说只建议部分 NF，不能改变实际 span 覆盖全句的错误。
首个 NF span 包含整句“既然 D4 第二阶段的边缘检查要求样布保持湿润…”，因此把 t1 的事实前提一并划入 NF；claims 同时保留该前提不能抵消。
前三个NF跨度各覆盖整个含事实前提的建议句；要求湿润、禁止L、浸泡盖盖均被同时列NF。
